text:
Yahoo Sports called Logan Stankoven one of the league's biggest scoring surprises, and the number explains why: 11 goals in 21 games after 21 in 81 last season. The goals look earned. He has 9.2 expected, so he is finishing a little hot, not wildly, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 91st percentile among forwards for chances from in front of the net last season.

The assists are another story. Carolina has scored 6.8 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, which has done a lot for his 20 points. On-ice luck like that fades.

He is also getting a bit less ice lately, 15:44 a night over the last ten games, nearly two minutes under his season average, though his pairing with Jackson Blake has The Hockey Writers calling them a dangerous duo. The Hurricanes take 63.9% of the expected goals at five on five when he plays.

Our projection has him between 24 and 37 goals, 30 in the middle. What to watch: whether the minutes come back.
